headline: Singapore and China prepare 20 economic initiatives spanning trade and research
summary: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong met Chinese Premier Li Qiang to strengthen bilateral ties. Both nations expect to launch over 20 initiatives covering trade, finance, and technological innovation.
why: Singapore serves as a key financial hub in Southeast Asia. Deeper economic pacts with China enhance bilateral investment and cross-border trade flows.

impacts.why: Deeper trade and financial agreements bolster Singapore's position as a regional hub.
